_comment: Hand-written titles and descriptions for the 34 pages that carry the
commercial load: the twelve product categories per locale, the industry
pages, and the two material explainers. Everything else on the site had its
metadata rebuilt mechanically from its own prose; these did not, because a
template applied to a money page produced copy like
'Federn für Weiße Ware | Weiße Ware bei Dietz Federn'.
Every factual claim here is already on the site: wire range 0.20-8.00 mm
DIN 2095 (compression spring pages). No certification, lead time or
capability is asserted that the site does not already state.
